  * We are working to release Otter MCP for all AI applications. Contact our Otter Support Team for help setting up Otter MCP with your AI application. 

Note: Google Gemini's support for MCP tools is not yet available, according to this thread; however, Gemini's command line interface (CLI) does support connecting to MCPs. Refer to Google's documentation for the most up-to-date information. 

## Is Google Gemini supported?Copy link

  * No.

Note: Refer to Google's documentation for the most up-to-date information.

  * You can access all meetings that you have captured in Otter, as well as any meetings shared with you from other users in your Workspace.

# Otter.ai Public API

17 days ago Updated

Plan required

This content is available for the Otter Enterprise plan and may require admin permissions.

Otter.ai’s Public API provides programmatic access to retrieve channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, action items, insights, outlines, and workspace details from your Otter account.

Getting Started: Otter's Public API is available for all Enterprise workspaces. If you do not see this feature for your workspace, contact your Otter account manager.

## API Fundamentals Copy link

Essential information for authenticating, paging through results, and understanding usage limits.

## Authentication Create and manage your API keys Copy link

All API requests require authentication using Bearer token authentication. Follow the steps below to create your API key. 

  1. Go to Integrations → Developer. 
Image
  2. Click Create key.

Image

  3. Click Copy and store the API key in a safe place.

Note: This is only visible once.

pages.title: Connect Otter to Zapier – Help Center (https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/27616131311127-Connect-Otter-to-Zapier)
pages.text: Connect Otter to Zapier – Help Center Skip to main content Articles in this section Connect Otter to Zapier Import recordings automatically to Otter using Zapier Trello <> Otter.ai Connecting Otter.ai to Zapier unlocks a new level of automation and efficiency. With seamless integration, you can easily connect Otter to your other favorite tools, automating repetitive tasks and streamlining workflows. Plan : This feature is available for all Pro, Business, and Enterprise accounts. Use Zapier to import audio files to Otter, or use Zapier to export Otter’s transcripts, summaries, action items, and more to other apps. Check out all the premade recipes to quickly get started on Zapier for free . Note : Importing audio files will consume your monthly minute limit . Zapier setup Follow the steps below to connect your Otter account to Zapier. Go to Zapier directly, or in Otter, go to Account Settings → Integrations , then click Connect next to Zapier. Create a new Zap. Under Account , click Sign in . If you have already created an API key, skip to step 6 . Note: Make sure Otter.ai is selected as the App before signing in. Go to the Account Settings → Developer . Note: The Developer tab may not be available on all plans. If you don’t see it, access it directly at otter.ai/setting/developer . Click Create key . An API key will be generated. Click Copy and save your API key in a secure location. Note: Your API key is only displayed once and can’t be viewed again. If you lose it, you’ll need to delete the existing API key and generate a new one. Paste your API key and click Connect . Your Otter account is now connected to Zapier. Continue building your Zap by selecting an event and configuring your workflow. Delete and regenerate your API key Regenerate your API key if you're running into any issues If you are experiencing issues or can't remember the code, you can delete and regenerate the API key. Go to Account Settings → Developer . Click the three-dot menu next to the API key you want to delete, then select Delete . Carefully review the pop-up details and click Delete Key to confirm. Click Create key to generate a new API key. What can I create with Zapier? Connect Otter with thousands of apps to automate your workflows. Otter currently supports the following Zapier events: New Recording — Trigger a workflow whenever a new recording is created in Otter. Import New Recordings into Otter — Automatically import recordings from another app into Otter. Browse Otter's premade templates in Zapier to quickly build workflows without starting from scratch. FAQs What can I automate with Zapier? Zapier lets you connect Otter with thousands of apps to automate workflows. For example, you can: Import recordings into Otter from other apps. Trigger workflows when a new recording is created. Connect Otter with productivity, storage, and collaboration tools. Do I need an API key to connect Otter to Zapier? Yes. You’ll need to generate an API key in Account Settings → Developer before connecting your Otter account to Zapier. How do I reconnect my Otter account in Zapier? If your connection expires or you revoke your API key, reconnect your Otter account by signing in again with a valid API key. Regenerate your API key if you no longer have access to your existing one. Which Zapier triggers and actions does Otter support? Otter currently supports the following Zapier events: New Recording Import New Recordings into Otter As new integrations become available, additional events may be added. Why isn’t my Zap working? If your Zap isn’t running as expected: Confirm your API key is still valid. Make sure your Otter account is connected. Verify the selected trigger or action is configured correctly. Check the Zap history in Zapier for any reported errors. If you require additional assistance connecting Otter to Zapier, check out Zapier's Help Center or contact our Otter Support team .
